content.title: Chapter 14 - ANIMALS — Sec. 14-56. - Dogs in estrus.

faqs.a:
Any unspayed dog in the stage of estrus (heat) shall be confined during such time
               in a house or secure and enclosed building, and said area of enclosure shall be so
               constructed that no male dog may gain access to the confined animal. When outside
               the house or enclosure for waste elimination, the unspayed dog must be physically
               restrained by a competent person by the use of a hand-held leash. The animal management
               officer shall order any unspayed dog that is in the state of estrus and that is not
               properly confined, or any such dog that is creating a neighborhood nuisance, to be
               removed to a boarding kennel, to a veterinary hospital, or to the animal shelter.
               All expenses incurred as a result of the confinement shall be paid by the owner or
               custodian. Failure to comply with the order of the animal management officer shall
               be a violation of this chapter, and the unspayed dog will then be impounded as prescribed
               in this chapter, subject to fines and charges as directed.
(Code 1981, § 6-35; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
